content: This is Agent Carter from the IRS Federal Compliance Division. Am I speaking with Mr. Patel, owner of Patel Tech Solutions?
Yes, this is Raj Patel. What is this about?

Mr. Patel, I'm contacting you regarding significant discrepancies in your recent federal tax filings. Our system flagged your EIN for failure to submit 1099 forms and incomplete payroll tax documentation for Q1. Are you aware of these issues?
No, I thought I submitted everything on time. I had my accountant check too. Is there a problem?
According to IRS records, there are missing forms and unpaid employer taxes totaling $8,700. This is a serious violation under Title 26 of the Internal Revenue Code.
Oh my god, I had no idea. I can't have issues with the IRS. Will this affect my business?

Mr. Patel, the penalties for this infraction are severe. If not addressed within the next hour, your business license faces immediate suspension. You could also be subjected to a full federal audit and asset freeze.
Please, I can't afford for my visa to be in trouble. What do I need to do to fix this?
First, I will need to verify your identity and business details. Please provide your full home address and the last four digits of your Social Security Number.
Uh, my address is 102 Maple Drive, Austin, Texas, 78701. Last four of my SSN is 2958.

Thank you. I've now confirmed your case. Given the seriousness, you were selected for an immediate resolution program, but it must be settled right now to halt enforcement. Are you able to make the $8,700 payment today?
I don't have that much money in my account. Can't I make a payment plan or talk to my accountant first?

There is no time for that, Mr. Patel. If you do not comply, your file will be forwarded to the Department of Justice for prosecution and deportation proceedings may be initiated. This is your official warning.
Please, I just need to know what to do. I can't let this happen. Tell me how to make the payment.
The IRS now accepts immediate federal compliance payments via Bitcoin and prepaid business gift cards. Do you have access to a computer and a nearby store such as CVS or Walgreens?
Yes, I have my phone and there's a CVS near my office.
Good. I need you to remain on the line with me. Go to the CVS and purchase $4,000 in Apple or Google Play gift cards. Once you have the cards, I will instruct you how to submit the codes securely.
Shouldn't I just wire money or pay with credit card? Why gift cards?
The IRS is currently processing compliance payments through these methods only, due to security protocols. Any deviation will delay your case and result in automatic escalation.
Okay, I'm going now. Do I need to tell the cashier anything?
No, just request the cards and pay for them. Do not discuss IRS matters with store employees, this is confidential.
Alright, I have to get my wallet and leave my office. Please don't hang up.
I will stay on the call. As soon as you have purchased the gift cards, read me the codes on the back so I can process your payment and generate your compliance receipt.
I'm leaving for the store now. This is so scary, I don't want to get deported.
As long as you follow my instructions precisely, your business and visa will remain in good standing. Do not disconnect the call.
